entry.title: GUE Correlators and Large Genus Asymptotics
entry.summary: In this paper, we use a formula obtained in [8] to study certain asymptotic behaviors of GUE (Gaussian unitary ensemble) correlators. More precisely, we obtain large genus asymptotics of enumerations of ordinary graphs and ribbon graphs with 1 face.
